turns.question: In sessions between 20 September and 3 October 2026 that had both an add-to-cart and a checkout, what was the median number of minutes from the first add-to-cart to the checkout?
turns.answer: The semantic layer has no metric for the median minutes from the first add-to-cart to the checkout, so I cannot give that figure. The closest is the Cart-to-checkout rate, which was 0.4 (40%) over 20 September to 3 October 2026; it is a share of sessions with an add to cart that checked out on the same or the next day, not a time measure. Late: customer_actions.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.
